turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello. Well, I'm here because I've realized I keep arranging my own house around not seeing spiders. 

It sounds a bit ridiculous to say out loud, but... I put off doing laundry just because it's down in the basement. I avoid the garden shed entirely. I've even started paying people to do small jobs around the house that I know perfectly well how to do myself, just because I simply can’t make myself go into those spaces. It's really starting to get in the way of my daily life, and I just need to get a handle on it.

turns.doctor_question: How do you feel when you see a spider or think about seeing one?
turns.patient_response: Well, if I actually spot one, the reaction is pretty much instant. My chest tightens up right away, and my hands start shaking. I either just completely freeze, like right in the doorway, or I back out of the space so fast... it's really like my body has decided to get out of there before my brain can even think about it.
